lines: Four knobs that drive whatever you map them to, standing in for a Kilpatrick Twister USB controller
Turn it to move the parameter mapped to it, and hold M with the pointer over it to arm it for mapping onto a control elsewhere in the patch
Note — nothing happens until a control here is mapped: hold M with the pointer over it, then click the control in the patch it should drive
Note — the name of the mapped control is printed under the knob once the mapping is made, and the mapping is kept in the patch

Twister.notes: No source is published. Everything above was read from the installed 2.0.9 binary, which is not stripped, together with the maker's page at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. Param 4 (LED BACKLIGHT) has no widget and no census position, so it gets no line: it is set by the module rather than turned. The M key is GLFW key 77 and the L key 76, both handled in KilpatrickKnob::onHoverKey and KilpatrickButton::onHoverKey at 0xc5f4; a knob takes only M. The MIDI menu headings come from MidiHelper::populateDriverMenu at 0x20468 and populateInputMenu at 0x20638, which prints MIDI Devices - Slot N for a helper with a MIDI output and MIDI Inputs - Slot N for one without.

Twister_Expander.notes: No source is published. Everything above was read from the installed 2.0.9 binary, which is not stripped, together with the maker's page at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. An incoming controller value of 0 to 127 is divided by 127 (the constant 0x3c010204 at 0x7544) and then scaled by the range switch. The three range settings are the tables at 0x2a798 and 0x2a7a4: scale 10 with offset -5, scale 5 with offset 0, and scale 10 with offset 0, and the switch frames are loaded bottom, middle, top, so they line up with the -5-5, 0-5 and 0-10 markings printed beside it.

Spinner.notes: No source is published. Everything above was read from the installed 2.0.9 binary, which is not stripped, together with the maker's page at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. The module declares 12 parameters: four buttons, the encoder, the two speed buttons, and five more with no name, no widget and no census position, which are the per-button latch flags and the backlight. None of those five can be clicked, so none gets a line. Index order is not panel order: the encoder is param 4 and sits above the four buttons, and the two speed buttons are params 5 and 6 between them.

Spinner_Expander.notes: No source is published. Everything above was read from the installed 2.0.9 binary, which is not stripped, together with the maker's page at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. Params 1 and 2 are the Up/Down Mode and Raw MIDI Mode flags; neither has a widget or a census position, so neither gets a line and both are covered by Menu lines. In Up/Down Mode a controller message with bit 0x40 set gives plus one and anything else minus one (0x186ec), held for five samples and written out at five volts per unit. The Settings heading is an eight-character literal assembled inline at 0x18f54.
